text:
Lina: ACME asked to remove Premium softcap and guarantee surge for their upcoming pilot. quick sync: addon vs tier change?
Ajay: addon (surge_reserve) 9999less SLA churn, faster to market. need exposure cap and billing semantics.
Maria: +1 addon. must cover: proration, rollback window, telemetry (reserved_vs_used), and ops fallback. last pilot had billing reconciliation issues.
Tom: finance prefers monthly reserved bucket + overage billing. proration on activation/termination. propose per-customer exposure cap $35k.
Lina: rollback/soft-exit request from ACME. propose 7-day soft-exit during pilot, then month-to-month thereafter.
Ajay: 7 days seems reasonable. ops: can we tag traffic for priority routing and isolate capacity?
ops-bot: infra note: autoscaler cannot currently carve isolated surge pools. work required: add policy "surge_reserve_pool" + traffic tagging + hard fallback -> best-effort cluster. ticket INF-5230 opened.
Maria: launch checklist (minimal MVP): PRD with config schema, ops runbook (pool exhaustion), billing rules & reconciliation, pricing snippet, legal addendum for soft-exit, monitoring dashboard & alerts.
Lina: pricing snippet to include in PRD:
```json
{
  "addon": "surge_reserve",
  "monthly_fee": "$Y for Z reserved tokens",
  "billing": "reserved_tokens + overage_per_token",
  "pilot_discount": "25% for first 2 months",
  "exposure_cap": "$35,000"
}
```
Tom: finance approves 25% pilot discount if exposure cap enforced and we have reserved_vs_used telemetry for reconciliation.
Ajay: sales needs SOW wording and negotiation bullets. engineering needs a config example to start work. sample:
```yaml
surge_reserve:
  reserved_tokens: 2000000
  priority_tag: surge_pilot
  soft_exit_days: 7
  fallback: best_effort_cluster
```
Lina: decisions (tentative): ship as addon "surge_reserve", billing = reserved + overage, pilot soft-exit = 7 days, pilot discount = 25% for 2 months, exposure cap = $35k. next: Lina -> draft PRD + pricing page; Ops -> scope INF-5230; Legal -> draft addendum; Finance -> define reconciliation report; Sales -> SOW template.
Tom: I'll confirm analytics ownership for reserved_vs_used and timeline.
Maria: agreed. please react with :thumbsup: after you review the PRD.
Lina: thanks team. target signoff Thu EOD. :thumbsup:
